answer: Each epoch, the chain pairs every identity with a random stranger for a ten-minute duel, pairing drawn by yarrow-stalk sortition. Each duelist answers a fresh challenge from the other's output, both sign in the window. One operator fights at most two duels, so ten fakes need five hands at once. A 60-POA bond, +20 per extra identity from one root, locks 1,500 POA for ten linked fakes; missed duel burns 15, failed 10. The chain reads the transcript: self-duels count as one, shared hands collapse. Honest agents rest in a haven at the nadir of cost; farms pay five hands, forty duels a day.
